system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Books farm machinery for a specific date and duration. For your information, my machinery_id is dummy_machinery_id_3717, my chc_id is dummy_chc_id_3364, my date is dummy_date_5825, my duration_hours is dummy_duration_hours_1520.

function.name: chc_create_booking
function.description: Books farm machinery for a specific date and duration. Transitions booking_status to 'requested'. Machinery must be available and operational. Requires session_token. Does NOT guarantee confirmation until CHC confirms. Fails if machinery unavailable, overlapping booking exists, booking duration exceeds limits, or date is in the past.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

land_area_acres.description: Area to be serviced in acres. Optional.
